verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Customer.io's own agent can run recurring scheduled tasks such as 'deliverability reports' and can 'report on how your messages perform'. That is thin first-party support for deliverability visibility, but nothing shows per-send bounce, complaint or blocklist signals, or guidance when deliverability degrades. missing for 10: documented per-send bounce/complaint metrics, blocklist monitoring, degradation alerts with actionable remediation guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can see bounce, complaint, and blocklist signals per send and get actionable guidance when deliverability degrades

citations.quote: You can set up recurring tasks that the agent runs automatically on a schedule—like deliverability reports, segment audits, and broadcast recaps.
report on how your messages perform
